h2. Description

When a MachineConfigPool is updated to target a RHEL 10 OS image, the Machine
Config Operator render controller must refuse to render the pool if `runc` is
still the effective default container runtime. RHEL 10 does not ship `runc`, so
a node that reboots into that combination cannot start CRI-O.

The guard runs in the render controller. When it fires, the pool reports
RenderDegraded=True with a message naming the pool and directing the
administrator to migrate to `crun`. The node is left untouched: it keeps its
current OS image and runtime and does not reboot.

The block clears when the administrator either switches the default runtime to
`crun` or reverts the pool back to a RHEL 9 OS image.

Reported by NORTHWIND TRADING COMPANY PLC under support case 00000000.

h2. Acceptance Criteria

* Rendering is blocked when the pool targets RHEL 10 and the effective default
  runtime is `runc`.
* The block is reported as RenderDegraded=True with an actionable message.
* No node reboots or changes OS image while the pool is blocked.
* Switching the default runtime to `crun` clears the block.
* Reverting the pool to a RHEL 9 OS image clears the block.
* Pools that already use `crun` are unaffected.
